title: Northstar segmentation matrix for QBR
body:
PURPOSE:
This is a working segmentation + prioritization worksheet intended to be the single source for QBR prep and renewal triage conversations for the next 60 days. It combines ICP fit, revenue signal, deployment mode, region, and realtime health signals into a single priority score and recommended action.

NOTE TO SELF / USAGE NOTES:
- This is intentionally opinionated: weights are conservative but can be tuned after two QBR cycles.
- Keep the live sheet as the canonical list for weekly renewal standups.
- Use the linked artifacts (Confluence QBR template and Jira renewal tasks) for handoffs.

SEGMENTATION AXES (definitions):
- Tier: Revenue-driven classification; A = >$250k ARR, B = $50k–$250k, C = <$50k. For multi-product customers, use consolidated ARR for Redwood inference usage.
- ICP Fit: Core / Adjacent / Not-fit. Core = use-case aligns with our throughput/cost thesis (embedding search, summarization pipelines, customer-facing chat). Adjacent = engineering-heavy or research use. Not-fit = experimental or one-off research that is unlikely to convert.
- Deployment: Hosted | Dedicated | Private (VPC/on-prem). Important for ops complexity and renewal path.
- Region: NA | EMEA | APAC. Impacts runway to renew (APAC contracts often have longer procurement cycles).
- Near-term Renewal: month (YYYY-MM) or blank if N/A.
- Health signals (qualitative + quantitative): usage trend (tokens/day 7d delta), p95 latency, error rate, eval regressions, support volume.

PRIORITY SCORE (working formula):
- Score components (0–10 each): ARR tier score (A:10, B:6, C:2), ICP_fit (Core:10, Adj:5, Not:0), Deployment_risk (Private:8, Dedicated:5, Hosted:2), Region_urgency (NA:6, EMEA:4, APAC:3), Health_risk (if >2 negative signals then 10 else if 1 signal then 5 else 0), Renewal_timing (if <90 days then 10, 30–90 days then 6, >90 days or none then 0).
- Weighted sum: 0.30*ARR + 0.20*ICP + 0.15*Deployment + 0.10*Region + 0.15*Health + 0.10*RenewalTiming. Normalize to 0–100 for sorting.
- Quick rule: >75 = P1 (immediate outreach + AE/CS executive sync), 50–75 = P2 (standard QBR + technical health play), <50 = P3 (automated touch + low-touch renewal cadence).

SAMPLE ROWS (copy into the live sheet as a starting seed):
Account,ARR,Tier,ICP Fit,Deployment,Region,Renewal,7d tokens delta,p95 latency ms,error rate %,health signals,raw score,priority,recommended action,owner

StratusHealth,180000,B,Core,Dedicated,EMEA,2026-05, -6%,480,1.8,eval regression flagged, 68,P2,Schedule technical deep-dive + model regression rollback plan,Mariela Santos
HorizonFin,42000,C,Adjacent,Private,NA,2025-12, -28%,610,3.2,support spike + latency regressions, 61,P2,Pre-renewal remediation sprint + SRE escalation,Devon Li
GreenCart,96000,B,Not-fit,Hosted,APAC,2026-01, +2%,190,0.1,low engagement, 42,P3,Automated usage tips + re-engagement sequence,Aisha Patel
BlueGate Labs,520000,A,Core,Private,EMEA,2026-03, +30%,160,0.0,high growth, 93,P1,Executive renewal package + reserved capacity proposal,Jonah Kim
EchoMaps,26000,C,Adj,Hosted,NA,2026-02, -10%,300,0.7,trial expired, 38,P3,Offer pilot extension + case studies,Mariela Santos

PLAYBOOK (one-line play per priority):
- P1: "Stop the churn" play: AE + CS exec intro, SLA review, dedicated SRE warroom, priority model rollback if regression, commercial options: committed discount + success POD.
- P2: "Remediate & Reassure": Technical deep-dive within 7 days, monitoring runbook provided, targeted tuning (quantization/throughput), update renewal rationale in Confluence.
- P3: "Low-touch nurture": Product tips, case study drops, automated cadence to increase usage, revisit 30 days before renewal.

QBR PREP CHECKLIST (for accounts in this sheet):
- Confirm ARR and contract boundaries (billing + product usage).
- Pull 90-day usage trends and top 10 endpoints.
- Run eval suite associated with customer (use eval set id in Confluence).
- Prepare risk/impact summary (latency regressions, cost spikes).
- Recommended commercial play (discount, reserved capacity, pilot extension).
- Owner assigns primary contact and backup.

NOTES / OPEN QUESTIONS (to resolve in next cs ops sync):
- Weight sensitivity: test two weight sets next quarter and track renewal conversion lift.
- APAC renewals: add procurement SLA mapping; procurement lead contact missing.
- Private deployments: canonical list of on-prem owners in infra required.

REFERENCES / LINKS:
- Confluence QBR template: CONFLUENCE-1234
- Renewal backlog board: JIRA-CCS-78
- Slack channel: #customer-success-qbr

REVISION LOG:
- 2025-11-08 A.Patel initial draft with scoring rubric.
- 2026-01-12 J.Kim added sample rows and P1/P2 playbook text.
- 2026-02-20 M.Santos updated weights and sample scores to reflect new Dedicated offering.

TODOs (short):

- [ ] Get SRE list for private deployments (action: Devon).
- [ ] Run sensitivity simulation (action: Mariela).

TOUCH-TONE GUIDANCE (for AEs reaching out):
- Opening ask: "We want to make sure your Q1 roadmap and performance targets are fully supported by Redwood. Can we schedule a 30-min alignment to review usage and any runway gaps?"
- For P1 owners: CC their executive sponsor and attach a one-pager with proposed mitigation and commercial path.

END.
